---
title: "1 Samuel"
---

# 1 Samuel

::: {.book-summary}
## Book Summary Insight

1 Samuel records Israel's transition from judges to kings, highlighting the rise of Samuel, Saul, and David. The book teaches that God looks upon the heart and raises leaders according to His purposes.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 1

<div class="key-verse">1 Samuel 1:27</div>

<div class="identifier">For this child I prayed</div>

### Why This Verse

Hannah's testimony

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records Hannah's prayer and the birth of Samuel. The key verse highlights God's ability to answer prayer and reverse impossible circumstances.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 2

<div class="key-verse">1 Samuel 2:30</div>

<div class="identifier">Them that honor Me I will honor</div>

### Why This Verse

Major theological statement

### Chapter Insight

This chapter contains Hannah's song and contrasts faithful and corrupt leadership. The key verse reveals God's sovereignty in exalting the humble and humbling the proud.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 3

<div class="key-verse">1 Samuel 3:10</div>

<div class="identifier">Speak, LORD, for thy servant heareth</div>

### Why This Verse

Samuel's call

### Chapter Insight

This chapter recounts God's call of Samuel. The key verse emphasizes the importance of listening and responding to God's voice.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 4

<div class="key-verse">1 Samuel 4:21</div>

<div class="identifier">Ichabod</div>

### Why This Verse

The glory has departed

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records Israel's defeat and the capture of the ark. The key verse demonstrates that God's presence cannot be manipulated through religious symbols.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 5

<div class="key-verse">1 Samuel 5:3</div>

<div class="identifier">Dagon fallen before the ark</div>

### Why This Verse

Famous demonstration of God's supremacy

### Chapter Insight

This chapter shows God's power over the Philistine god Dagon. The key verse reveals God's supremacy over all false gods.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 6

<div class="key-verse">1 Samuel 6:20</div>

<div class="identifier">Who is able to stand before the LORD?</div>

### Why This Verse

Response to divine holiness

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records the return of the ark to Israel. The key verse highlights God's holiness and the need to approach Him with reverence.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 7

<div class="key-verse">1 Samuel 7:12</div>

<div class="identifier">Ebenezer</div>

### Why This Verse

"Thus far the LORD has helped us"

### Chapter Insight

This chapter describes Israel's repentance and victory at Mizpah. The key verse commemorates God's help and faithfulness through the Ebenezer stone.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 8

<div class="key-verse">1 Samuel 8:7</div>

<div class="identifier">They have rejected Me from reigning over them</div>

### Why This Verse

Israel demands a king

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records Israel's request for a king. The key verse reveals that Israel's demand reflected a rejection of God's kingship.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 9

<div class="key-verse">1 Samuel 9:6</div>

<div class="identifier">There is a man of God in this city</div>

### Why This Verse

Saul seeks Samuel

### Chapter Insight

This chapter introduces Saul and God's preparation of him as king. The key verse demonstrates God's sovereign direction of seemingly ordinary events.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 10

<div class="key-verse">1 Samuel 10:9</div>

<div class="identifier">God gave him another heart</div>

### Why This Verse

Saul's transformation

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records Saul's anointing and public selection as king. The key verse emphasizes that leadership comes from God's appointment.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 11

<div class="key-verse">1 Samuel 11:13</div>

<div class="identifier">The LORD has wrought salvation in Israel</div>

### Why This Verse

Saul's early success

### Chapter Insight

This chapter recounts Saul's early victory over the Ammonites. The key verse highlights God's deliverance through the king He provided.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 12

<div class="key-verse">1 Samuel 12:24</div>

<div class="identifier">Fear the LORD and serve Him faithfully</div>

### Why This Verse

Samuel's farewell exhortation

### Chapter Insight

This chapter contains Samuel's farewell address. The key verse calls Israel to fear the Lord and serve Him faithfully.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 13

<div class="key-verse">1 Samuel 13:14</div>

<div class="identifier">A man after His own heart</div>

### Why This Verse

Defining description of David

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records Saul's unlawful sacrifice and disobedience. The key verse demonstrates that obedience is more important than expediency.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 14

<div class="key-verse">1 Samuel 14:6</div>

<div class="identifier">Nothing restrains the LORD from saving</div>

### Why This Verse

Jonathan's faith

### Chapter Insight

This chapter recounts Jonathan's faith-driven victory over the Philistines. The key verse teaches that God can save regardless of human resources.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 15

<div class="key-verse">1 Samuel 15:22</div>

<div class="identifier">To obey is better than sacrifice</div>

### Why This Verse

One of the most quoted verses in Samuel

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records Saul's rejection as king. The key verse emphasizes that obedience is better than sacrifice.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 16

<div class="key-verse">1 Samuel 16:7</div>

<div class="identifier">Man looks on the outward appearance</div>

### Why This Verse

God chooses David

### Chapter Insight

This chapter describes David's anointing. The key verse reveals that God looks at the heart rather than outward appearance.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 17

<div class="key-verse">1 Samuel 17:45</div>

<div class="identifier">I come in the name of the LORD</div>

### Why This Verse

David before Goliath

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records David's victory over Goliath. The key verse highlights faith in God's power rather than confidence in human strength.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 18

<div class="key-verse">1 Samuel 18:1</div>

<div class="identifier">The soul of Jonathan was knit to David</div>

### Why This Verse

Famous friendship passage

### Chapter Insight

This chapter describes David's rise and Saul's growing jealousy. The key verse shows how God's favor distinguished David.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 19

<div class="key-verse">1 Samuel 19:23</div>

<div class="identifier">The Spirit of God came upon him</div>

### Why This Verse

Saul among the prophets again

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records Saul's increasing attempts to kill David. The key verse demonstrates God's protection of His chosen servant.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 20

<div class="key-verse">1 Samuel 20:42</div>

<div class="identifier">The LORD be between me and thee</div>

### Why This Verse

David and Jonathan covenant

### Chapter Insight

This chapter highlights the covenant friendship between David and Jonathan. The key verse emphasizes loyalty, love, and faithfulness.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 21

<div class="key-verse">1 Samuel 21:9</div>

<div class="identifier">There is none like that</div>

### Why This Verse

Goliath's sword

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records David's flight from Saul. The key verse demonstrates God's provision during seasons of hardship.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 22

<div class="key-verse">1 Samuel 22:2</div>

<div class="identifier">Everyone in distress gathered to him</div>

### Why This Verse

Beginning of David's mighty men

### Chapter Insight

This chapter recounts Saul's massacre of the priests. The key verse illustrates the tragic consequences of unchecked jealousy and rebellion.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 23

<div class="key-verse">1 Samuel 23:16</div>

<div class="identifier">Jonathan strengthened his hand in God</div>

### Why This Verse

Encouragement in adversity

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records David's protection of Keilah and continued flight. The key verse emphasizes seeking God's guidance in difficult decisions.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 24

<div class="key-verse">1 Samuel 24:6</div>

<div class="identifier">I will not stretch forth my hand</div>

### Why This Verse

David spares Saul

### Chapter Insight

This chapter recounts David sparing Saul's life. The key verse demonstrates respect for God's authority despite personal injustice.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 25

<div class="key-verse">1 Samuel 25:32</div>

<div class="identifier">Blessed be the LORD who sent thee</div>

### Why This Verse

Abigail's wisdom

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records David, Nabal, and Abigail. The key verse highlights wisdom and restraint in preventing needless vengeance.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 26

<div class="key-verse">1 Samuel 26:23</div>

<div class="identifier">The LORD renders to every man</div>

### Why This Verse

David's integrity

### Chapter Insight

This chapter again shows David sparing Saul. The key verse reinforces David's trust in God rather than taking matters into his own hands.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 27

<div class="key-verse">1 Samuel 27:1</div>

<div class="identifier">David said in his heart</div>

### Why This Verse

Turning point toward Philistine refuge

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records David's refuge among the Philistines. The key verse reveals the complexity of living by faith during uncertainty.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 28

<div class="key-verse">1 Samuel 28:15</div>

<div class="identifier">Why hast thou disturbed me?</div>

### Why This Verse

Samuel and Saul at Endor

### Chapter Insight

This chapter recounts Saul's visit to the medium of Endor. The key verse demonstrates the despair that results from rejecting God's guidance.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 29

<div class="key-verse">1 Samuel 29:6</div>

<div class="identifier">As the LORD liveth, thou hast been upright</div>

### Why This Verse

Philistine assessment of David

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records David's dismissal from the Philistine army. The key verse reveals God's providential protection from compromise.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 30

<div class="key-verse">1 Samuel 30:6</div>

<div class="identifier">David encouraged himself in the LORD</div>

### Why This Verse

Widely quoted encouragement verse

### Chapter Insight

This chapter describes David's victory after the attack on Ziklag. The key verse emphasizes finding strength in the Lord during crisis.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 31

<div class="key-verse">1 Samuel 31:4</div>

<div class="identifier">Saul fell upon his sword</div>

### Why This Verse

Death of Saul

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records Saul's death. The key verse marks the tragic conclusion of a king who repeatedly rejected God's authority.
:::
